summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] control code shape; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title), which passes a single two-item argument; rich/console.py adds set_window_title gated only on is_terminal, returning a bool, with the spec docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run (per instructions), and nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only; mypy and pytest have not been executed.
